🧠 2. Executive Summary
A broad high-severity intrusion campaign was detected spanning 12 distinct attack chains covering the full MITRE ATT&CK kill chain.
The adversary demonstrated diverse capabilities: token impersonation, phishing-based initial access, firmware-level persistence via UEFI implant, shadow credential abuse, NTLM relay attacks, memory-only malware, email-based collection, and steganographic data exfiltration.
Attack categories observed: Reconnaissance, Initial Access, Execution, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion, Credential Access, Discovery, Lateral Movement, Command & Control, Collection, Exfiltration, Resource Development, Impact.
Immediate containment, full endpoint forensics, and domain-wide review are required.
